description: Adversarial review remediation — truly atomic tasks, one small edit each

tasks.title: Fix abort signal in retry sleep (executor.ts)
Expand isReadOnlyShellCommand regex (executor.ts)
tasks.prompt:
Edit packages/agent/src/executor.ts to expand the isReadOnlyShellCommand regex.

Find the isReadOnlyShellCommand function. It has a regex that splits on shell operators. Expand it to also handle |& (pipe with stderr).

Current regex might be something like: /(?:&&|\|\||\|;)/
Change it to: /(?:&&|\|\||\|&|;)/

This adds support for |& which is bash's pipe-with-stderr operator.

IMPORTANT:
- Do NOT run pnpm install
- Do NOT run pnpm build
- Do NOT run pnpm test
- Just make this ONE regex edit and call finish
- The file is at packages/agent/src/executor.ts relative to the project root

tasks.prompt:
